title: A New Friend
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about a new friend that you met in your English class.
notes: What things does he/she impress you with?
sampleResponse:
Dear Jill,

How are you? I'm very glad to hear from you. I am a second-year student studying Civil Engineering at Mien Trung University of Civil Engineering. In your last letter you asked me about my new friend. Now I'll tell you about her.

Her name is Thao, whom I met in the English class. She is beautiful, slim and has straight blonde hair and black eyes. She smiles brightly and is friendly.

She is friendly, clever and really hard-working. She is also well-dressed and well-behaved. She is very good at her studies and speaks English very well.

She made a big impression on me the first time we met. She is very funny, kind and modest. She likes to help me improve my English. I really want to introduce her to you.

I am looking forward to hearing from you as soon as possible.

Love,

title: Your Hobbies
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your hobbies.
notes: How do you spend time on them?
How do you feel about them?
sampleResponse:
Dear Minh,

How are you? I'm very glad to hear from you. I am a second-year student studying Civil Engineering at Mien Trung University of Civil Engineering. In your last letter, you asked me about my hobbies. Now I'll tell you about them: reading books and playing badminton.

I usually spend some time every evening reading novels or short stories. Reading not only entertains me but also helps me improve my vocabulary and knowledge about the world.

At weekends, I often play badminton with my friends in the park near my house. It is a great way to exercise and stay healthy. We usually play for about two hours, and I always feel full of energy after the game.

I believe that my hobbies make my life more enjoyable and meaningful. They also help me relax after stressful schoolwork.

I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,

title: Your Favorite Sport
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your favorite sport.
notes: What kind of sport do you like best?
sampleResponse:
Dear John,

How are you? I'm very glad to hear from you. In your last letter, you asked me about my favorite sport. Now I'll tell you about it. My favorite sport is football because it is exciting and healthy.

I usually play football with my friends at the weekend in the park near my house. We often play for about two hours, and I always feel happy and energetic after the match. I also watch football on TV to learn more useful skills.

My favorite athlete is Lionel Messi. He is a great player, and I admire his talent, speed and hard work.

I believe football helps me relax after school and makes my life more interesting.

I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,

title: Your Current Job
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your current job.
notes: Would you like to change anything in your job?
sampleResponse:
Dear My,

How are you? I'm very glad to hear from you. I am a fourth-year student studying Civil Engineering at Mien Trung University of Civil Engineering. In your last letter, you asked me about my current job. Now, I am working as an intern at a construction company.

My main duties are helping engineers with their work, checking simple documents, and learning how to design buildings. I also visit construction sites to observe how people work there.

I really like this job because I can gain useful experience and improve my skills. My colleagues are friendly and always help me.

However, I would like to have more responsibilities so I can learn more. I also hope to get a full-time job in the future.

I am looking forward to hearing from you as soon as possible.

Best wishes,

title: Your House
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your house you are living in.
notes: Does it have any special features?
sampleResponse:
Dear Huy,

How are you doing? I'm very glad to hear from you. I am a second-year student studying Civil Engineering at Mien Trung University of Civil Engineering. In your last letter, you asked me about my house. Now I'll tell you a bit about my house, where I live with my parents.

It is a two-story house in a quiet neighborhood, not far from my university, so it is very convenient for studying.

From the outside, it looks quite modern, with a small garden in front that my mom loves to take care of. The walls are painted a soft blue color, which makes it feel very welcoming.

Inside, we have a spacious living room where we often watch TV together in the evenings. My favorite part is my room on the second floor. It has a large window with a nice view, and it is perfect for relaxing and studying.

I am looking forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Best,

title: Favourite Shopping Centre
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your favourite shopping centre in your city.
notes: Where do you often go shopping?
How and when do you often get there?
sampleResponse:
Dear Huy,

How are you doing? I'm very glad to hear from you. I am a second-year student studying Civil Engineering at Mien Trung University of Civil Engineering. In your last letter, you asked me about my favourite place for shopping. Now I will tell you about it. My favorite place is Vincom Center in the city. It is a really modern and large shopping mall downtown.

I usually go there every weekend, especially on Saturday afternoons if I have free time. I often go there by motorbike with my friends, and sometimes I go with my family by car.

Vincom Center has everything! There are many clothing shops, a big supermarket, a cinema, and lots of restaurants and cafés. I love trying new food there. There is also a great bookshop on the top floor. It is a very lively place with a great atmosphere.

I am looking forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Best,

title: Favourite Food
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your favourite food.
sampleResponse:
Hi Alan,

Thanks for your letter – it was great to hear from you. Well, you know I like vegetables and fruits, so my favourite food is salad.

I love it not only because of its delicious flavour but also because of its health benefits. Moreover, it is really easy to prepare. There are a lot of ways and ingredients to make this food. It often includes vegetables; for example: cucumbers, carrots, onions, tomatoes. All of them are sliced and mixed together with salt, sugar, vinegar or some kinds of sauce. All make a very tasteful salad.

So that's my favourite food. How about you? Write soon and let me know.

All the best,

title: Inviting to Stay
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about inviting her to stay at your house.
sampleResponse:
Dear Mary,

I'm very glad to receive your letter this morning and much happier to know that you're going to Hanoi next week. You said you are going to have a week here, so would you like to come and stay with my family?

We can share my comfortable room. All members in my family are very hospitable, so just make yourself at home. You're welcome to stay as long as you like. I would be your free tour guide around the city. This is summer time, so there is no problem about time, homework or anything. There are a lot of interesting places to go and full of exciting activities to do, especially swimming. Moreover, the city is so attractive in this season. I'm sure you will like it.

Please write and tell me if you would like to stay with my family. My best wishes to your parents.

title: Last Holiday
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about your last holiday.
notes: Who did you spend your holiday with?
Did you enjoy it? Why/ Why not?
sampleResponse:
Hello John,

Last summer, my family and I decided to spend our holiday in Da Nang and Quang Nam. We went there by plane. First, we spent 3 days in Da Nang. The beaches in Da Nang were very beautiful and clean, so we went swimming twice a day. We also visited many beauty spots like Ba Na Hill, Linh Ung pagoda, Marble Mountain and enjoyed many delicious foods. Then we moved to Hoi An, Quang Nam by coach. We spent one day there to enjoy the beautiful scenery of lanterns and ancient houses along the river.

This wonderful trip helped us to get rid of worries and gave us health and enthusiasm to be back to work, so I really enjoyed it.

Love,

title: Keep Fit and Healthy
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives how to keep fit and healthy.
notes: Should he reduce the food each meal?
Does he need to change any habits?
sampleResponse:
Hello Tim,

The first and the most important thing is not to reduce the food you eat daily. You can change the menu and the way you eat. You should eat more vegetables and fruits instead of fast food. Moreover, eating on time helps you prevent strong feeling of hunger.

Secondly, it will be better if you keep on doing exercise every day. Exercise can help you stay healthy and keep fit. I like swimming and doing yoga but if you don't have much time, you can go walking or running around the park near your house.

Finally, some small changes in your life will also help you to keep fit. For example, you should avoid bad habits like smoking, drinking or even staying up late which make your health worse.

I hope you always have good health.

title: Environmental Problem
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about one environmental problem that your city is facing and what are people doing to solve it?
notes: What environmental problem is your city facing?
What is the cause of the problem?
What are local people doing to solve the problem?
sampleResponse:
Dear John,

In my city, the environmental problem that needs worrying the most is littering. The streets are always full of rubbish, which makes the city look ugly.

I think the main reason is the people's poor awareness. They get used to throwing their waste anywhere just because it's convenient for them.

We're trying a lot to solve this problem. First of all, the city authority usually holds events to raise people's awareness about environment protection like Waste Collecting Day. In addition, more litter bins are placed on the pavements. These bins are beautifully decorated with really meaningful slogans. They will probably encourage people to put rubbish into the bins.

I hope my city will be cleaner in the future.

Love,

title: Important Invention
prompt: Write a letter (about 120 words) to your friend/colleague/parents/relatives about an important invention that you think has positively influenced your life.
notes: Why is it important to you?
sampleResponse:
Hello Suzy,

I can answer you immediately that computer is the invention positively influencing my life. It is used in almost all fields of my life for many purposes such as entertainment, education, and work. It contains all things that I need: helpful information, connection to friends or relatives and the technology for modern life. At work, the computer helps minimize the work that I have to do. It helps me in maths calculation, word processing as well as document saving. At home, with computer I can play lots of video games, watch movies, listen to music or chat on the Internet.

I can't imagine if one day I don't have the computer. It has become a part of my life because it saves my money, time and materials. Thanks to the computer with the Internet, I can make friends with you!

Yours,
